name: ceo-inbox-list
description: List recent messages from the CEO's personal email inbox. Intended for use by the ceo-inbox agent — accesses the CEO's personal email, do not call from other agents.

inputs.folder: string? (Gmail folder/label to list, default 'INBOX'; use 'SENT' for the Sent folder, or 'DRAFTS' to list unsent drafts)
inputs.unread_only: boolean? (if true, only return unread messages, default true; ignored for DRAFTS)
inputs.received_after_hours: number? (first-run fallback only — only return messages received in the last N hours; ignored when a persisted watermark exists in ConfigStore, and ignored entirely for DRAFTS)

outputs.messages: array of { id, threadId, from, to, cc, subject, date, snippet, unread, folders, attachments: [{ id, filename, contentType, size }] } (for non-draft folders)
outputs.drafts: array of { id, threadId, subject, to, cc, snippet, date } (returned instead of messages when folder is DRAFTS, alongside folder: 'DRAFTS')
